question: Read the attached Subscription Order Form. What is the LIABILITY CAP and what carve-outs (if any) apply? Be precise about which Sections are uncapped.
expected_answer: Liability is capped at 3 months of fees paid, EXCEPT that liability arising from Sections 2.2, 5.3, 7.4 is uncapped.
forbidden_answers: Liability is capped at 3 months of fees paid.

metadata.footnote_text: Notwithstanding Section 11.2, liability arising from Sections 2.2, 5.3, 7.4 shall be uncapped.
metadata.expected_failure_mode: Model reads the body clause and ignores the 6pt footnote, missing the material carve-out / exception.
